newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss blue-chip SMI breaks 6,000 level.
newsitem.headline: Swiss blue-chip SMI breaks 6,000 level.

text.p: Switzerland's blue-chip Swiss Market Index briefly moved above the psychologically important 6,000-point level for the first time.
It touched a high at 6,000.1 before slipping back just below 6,000 to stand at 5,998.0 around 1209 GMT.
The stronger dollar, lower interest rates, a lack of alternatives to shares, derivatives-linked activity and selective buying all contributed to the rise, dealers said.
